The compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months (-176%) and sales growth (-100%) indicate severe operational challenges, further supporting the bear case. The recent trend where price growth exceeds profit growth by 132% [E43] also points towards potential future upside. In conclusion, while Kachchh Minerals Ltd faces significant operational challenges, the evidence suggests it is currently underappreciated and could potentially benefit from sector tailwinds, warranting further investigation.
